content: PRIMARY-VERIFIED (PyPI JSON + mcp_types/version.py at GitHub main): mcp 2.0.0 released 2026-07-28; latest 2.3.0; 1.30.0 last 1.x maintenance. Dual-era: HANDSHAKE_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS=(2024-11-05,2025-03-26,2025-06-18,2025-11-25), MODERN=(2026-07-28,); OLDEST_SUPPORTED=2024-11-05 so SIF current 2024-11-05 clients keep working; one streamable_http_app/stdio server serves all eras without flags; client probes server/discover then falls back to initialize. Wire types split to mcp-types==2.3.0 (deps only pydantic>=2.12+typing-extensions; mcp.types permanent alias). HTTP client httpx2>=2.10 (latest 2.16.0 needs py>=3.11; py3.10 resolves 2.14.0); httpx/httpx-sse removed; TLS via truststore. New deps: opentelemetry-api, pyjwt[crypto], sse-starlette>=3, python-multipart, jsonschema, typing-inspection. mcp-codemod 0.1.3 is COMMUNITY (8crsk, libcst), not official; irrelevant to SIF hand-rolled server.
